title: BTC whale that accumulated for 6 years moves $52.2M in BTC to Cumberland
summary: A whale wallet that had steadily accumulated Bitcoin over the past six years transferred 800 BTC, worth about $52.2 million, to crypto market maker and OTC trading platform Cumberland about one hour ago, according to Onchain Lens. Deposits to trading venues are typically interpreted as potential selling activity.Onchain Lens said the whale externally moved a total of 2,000 BTC worth about $130 million today, including the transfer to Cumberland and another 1,200 BTC, worth about $78.3 million, to a new address.

summary: Jesse Pollak, a developer at Coinbase’s Ethereum layer-two network Base, said on X that Coinbase and Base plan to launch tokens backed one-for-one by real-world stocks.Pollak said Robinhood Chain made a strong move by launching stock tokens in an EVM environment. While Base had lagged in the segment, Pollak said Coinbase and Base would address that. Pollak added that tokens linked one-for-one to real-world stocks would offer advantages in credibility, capital efficiency and institutional adoption.
